title: SignalEvent
description: Canonical envelope for a single telemetry event published to the `signal.events.v1` Kafka topic by the event-producer. Every downstream job (aggregation, anomaly-detection, session-analytics) assumes this shape.

event_id.description: UUIDv4 assigned by the producer. Used as the Kafka message key is `source`, not this — event_id is for idempotency/tracing.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version. Consumers should branch on this if the shape ever changes, rather than assuming the latest shape.

timestamp.description: Event time in RFC 3339 / ISO 8601, UTC.

attributes.description: Source-specific payload. Deliberately permissive (additionalProperties: true) — this is where per-source enrichment lives — but the fields consumed by the streaming jobs are constrained below.

user_id.description: SHA-256 hash, not the raw identifier (see docs/SECURITY.md).
